cisa_kev.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

euvd.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

advisory.description: SSA-166980: PHP2Shell Vulnerabilities in Siemens Products
advisory.summary:
On October 21, 2026, the PHP project and security researchers disclosed two critical, unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in the core PHP language runtime known as "php2shell" (tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). This advisory covers the status of impact of various Siemens software products.

As a general security measure, Siemens strongly recommends to protect network access to devices with appropriate mechanisms. In order to operate the devices in a protected IT environment, Siemens recommends to configure the environment according to Siemens' operational guidelines, and to follow the recommendations in the product manuals.

Siemens is actively monitoring the situation and assessing the implications of these vulnerabilities on our portfolio. Because this evaluation is ongoing, our findings are subject to change as new technical details and vendor updates emerge. We will publish updated findings, guidance, and remediation recommendations as soon as they become available.

advisory.description: PHP insecure error handling and state management
advisory.summary: PHP insecurely handles multiple combinations of memory allocations and error conditions. These behaviors can allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. Successful exploitation depends on a number of factors including the specific PHP application being targeted, the SAPI and web server, error handling and memory resource configuration, and platform or OS-level memory protections. Without significant analysis effort to prove otherwise, any application running on a vulnerable version of PHP should be considered vulnerable and exploitable.

descriptions.value: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

PHP utiliza la función “longjmp()” para los errores de falta de memoria (OOM), con el fin de salir del contexto actual y abortar la gestión de la solicitud. Es posible que algunos contextos no tengan debidamente en cuenta esta situación y dejen la memoria de la solicitud en un estado no inicializado antes de realizar una asignación. El procedimiento posterior de limpieza de la solicitud podría leer o realizar una ramificación en esta memoria. Existen múltiples estrategias de gestión de OOM que pueden desencadenar esta condición de forma sistemática y dar lugar a la ejecución remota de código (RCE).
